Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class FeatureServiceManagement

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.FeatureServiceManagement
@Service public class FeatureServiceManagement extends Object
Service class that provides operations related to features, interacting with both feature and storage services. It acts as a facade for managing features and their association with storage entities.

This service handles the conversion between data transfer objects (DTOs) and entities, and ensures the correct business logic is applied when interacting with feature and storage services.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
